CONTROLS.NAME: levels
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Reduces the color space, resulting contour lines instead of smooth shading. 100% is all colors, 0% is only 2 or 3.

CONTROLS.NAME: color_mode
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: OFF is normal. ON is grainy and inverse.

CONTROLS.NAME: arranged
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Arrange the spheres randomly (OFF) or on a grid (ON).

CONTROLS.NAME: rotation
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Define a rotation direction and amount.

CONTROLS.NAME: xyPos
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Define a direction for the spheres to move.

CONTROLS.NAME: feedback
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Add a motion blur effect. 100% will freeze the scene. 0% is no blur.
